<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Synthetic\Accessors\Formats;

use Synthetic\Accessors\Accessor;

/** Reads `KEY=value` lines. Blank lines and lines that start with `#` are skipped; a value may be wrapped in one pair of matching quotes. */
final class EnvAccessor implements Accessor
{
    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $values = [];

    public function __construct(string $source)
    {
        foreach (preg_split('/\r?\n/', $source) ?: [] as $raw) {
            $line = trim($raw);
            if ($line === '' || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
                continue;
            }
            $eq = strpos($line, '=');
            if ($eq === false || $eq === 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $key = trim(substr($line, 0, $eq));
            $value = trim(substr($line, $eq + 1));
            if (strlen($value) >= 2 && ($value[0] === '"' || $value[0] === "'") && $value[strlen($value) - 1] === $value[0]) {
                $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
            }
            $this->values[$key] = $value;
        }
    }

    public function get(string $key, ?string $fallback = null): ?string
    {
        return $this->values[$key] ?? $fallback;
    }

    public function has(string $key): bool
    {
        return array_key_exists($key, $this->values);
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        return $this->values;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require __DIR__ . '/../src/Accessor.php';
require __DIR__ . '/../src/Formats/EnvAccessor.php';
require __DIR__ . '/../src/Formats/JsonAccessor.php';

use Synthetic\Accessors\Formats\EnvAccessor;
use Synthetic\Accessors\Formats\JsonAccessor;

$failures = 0;
function check(string $name, bool $ok): void
{
    global $failures;
    echo ($ok ? "ok   " : "FAIL ") . $name . "\n";
    if (!$ok) {
        $failures++;
    }
}

$env = new EnvAccessor("HOST=localhost\nPORT=3000\n");
check('reads KEY=value lines', $env->get('HOST') === 'localhost' && $env->get('PORT') === '3000');

$env = new EnvAccessor("# a comment\n\nKEY=value\n");
check('skips blank lines and comments', $env->all() === ['KEY' => 'value']);

$env = new EnvAccessor("A=\"one two\"\nB='three'\n");
check('strips one pair of matching quotes', $env->get('A') === 'one two' && $env->get('B') === 'three');

$env = new EnvAccessor('KEY=value');
check('answers the fallback for a key that is not there', $env->get('MISSING', 'none') === 'none' && $env->has('KEY') && !$env->has('MISSING'));

$json = new JsonAccessor('{"name":"x","count":3}');
check('json keeps the string values of an object', $json->all() === ['name' => 'x']);

exit($failures === 0 ? 0 : 1);

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Synthetic\Accessors\Formats;

use Synthetic\Accessors\Accessor;

/** Reads `KEY=value` lines. Blank lines and lines that start with `#` are skipped; a value may be wrapped in one pair of matching quotes. */
final class EnvAccessor implements Accessor
{
    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $values = [];

    public function __construct(string $source)
    {
        foreach (preg_split('/\r?\n/', $source) ?: [] as $raw) {
            $line = trim($raw);
            if ($line === '' || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
                continue;
            }
            $eq = strpos($line, '=');
            if ($eq === false || $eq === 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $key = trim(substr($line, 0, $eq));
            $value = trim(substr($line, $eq + 1));
            if (strlen($value) >= 2 && ($value[0] === '"' || $value[0] === "'") && $value[strlen($value) - 1] === $value[0]) {
                $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
            }
            $this->values[$key] = $value;
        }
    }

    public function get(string $key, ?string $fallback = null): ?string
    {
        return $this->values[$key] ?? $fallback;
    }

    public function has(string $key): bool
    {
        return array_key_exists($key, $this->values);
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        return $this->values;
    }
}

content.text: Both suites pass. Next I'll record the one choice that someone could later question, which is how the prefix is recognised.

input.title: EnvAccessor drops only a leading literal `export ` (space), in both packages
input.rationale: `export KEY=value` is read as `KEY=value`: after the line is trimmed and found not blank or a comment, a leading `export ` is removed and the rest is left-trimmed, so `export   KEY=v` also works. The same code shape is in packages/js/src/accessors/formats/env-accessor.ts and packages/php/src/Formats/EnvAccessor.php (ADR-1). A key that merely starts with the word (`export=1`, `EXPORT_KEY=2`) is unchanged, `export NOVALUE` (no `=`) is still skipped like any line without `=`, and `# export X=1` stays a comment. Tests for these cases are in both packages.
input.alternatives: Regex `^export\s+` (also tab after export): rejected, the request named the `export ` prefix and a tab-separated form is not a habit worth widening the grammar for; easy to add later in both packages at once. Strip `export` before the comment check: rejected, a commented `# export X=1` must stay a comment. Treat `export NOVALUE` as a key with empty value (shell semantics): rejected, the accessor skips every line without `=` and that stays uniform. Change the PHP package in a later PR: rejected by ADR-1.

content.text:
`EnvAccessor` now reads `export KEY=value` as `KEY=value`. I made the change in both the JS and PHP packages, and both test suites pass. I haven't committed anything.

- **Both packages:** ADR-1 says a behavior change in one package goes into the other in the same pull request. So I changed `packages/js/src/accessors/formats/env-accessor.ts` and `packages/php/src/Formats/EnvAccessor.php`.
- **How it works:** after the blank/comment check, a leading `export ` is dropped and the rest is left-trimmed. `export   PORT=3000` also gives `PORT`.
- **What stays the same:**
  - `export=1` and `EXPORT_KEY=2` are still ordinary keys.
  - `# export X=1` is still a comment.
  - `export NOVALUE` (no `=`) is still skipped, like any line without `=`.
  - A tab after `export` is not treated as the prefix.
- **Tests:** two new cases in each package. `reads \`export KEY=value\` as KEY=value` covers plain, extra-space and quoted values mixed with a plain line. `only a leading \`export \` is dropped` covers the unchanged cases above.
- **Record:** I recorded this as ADR-2, which is still `proposed` and waits for a person to accept it. It captures the prefix rule and the alternatives I turned down (a `\s+` regex, shell-style `export NOVALUE`). It is not linked to a path, and I did not supersede ADR-1, since ADR-2 follows it.

When you commit, include `.mnema/`. Git status shows two untracked paths there: a new public key (`.mnema/keys/d8fb7c65….pub`) and its `tails/` directory. A hook note said this session's key founded a new identity (`mnid:7e28947e`) next to the existing one (`mnid:3b2c3f61`). If that key is really you on another machine, the hook said to run `mnema key request --anchor mnid:3b2c3f61`. Otherwise there's nothing to do.
